Very good
Nov 2025 • Couples
Bar in the lobby of the La Festa Phu Quoc hotel. Pleasant interior. Good service. The terrace has a great view of the bay and in the evening you can enjoy the shows taking place on the bay.

If you are very hungry, this may not be the right place, as the menu only offers snacks for meals. The display case was very impressive and decorative, but I didn't try any of the cakes that day.

The High Tea offer looks very impressive in the advertising image, but it was quite a big disappointment. The sweet dishes were OK (although nothing special), but the savoury selection and especially the sandwiches were a real disappointment (there was 0.5 mm of filling between two slices of bread).

The Coffee Appreciation course at iL Salone was very good and, in addition, free for those staying at the hotel. We received information about Vietnamese coffee and were able to prepare various exciting signature coffees.

Dear Yllar,

Thank you for sharing your detailed feedback regarding your experience at iL Salone. We are delighted that you enjoyed our lobby’s interior, the stunning views of the bay from our terrace, and especially our Coffee Appreciation course.

However, we sincerely appreciate your honest feedback regarding our High Tea offering. We are disappointed to hear that the savory selection, particularly the sandwiches, did not meet your expectations in terms of quality and value. Please be assured that your comments have been shared with our Pastry Chef and culinary team to review our recipes and ensure our offerings match the high standards shown in our advertisements.

We hope to welcome you back soon to try our impressive cake selection or another signature coffee!

Best Regards,
Justin Kim
